name: Passive Capacitor — USB — CP

selection_hints: Select based on required footprint between CP_EIA-6032-28_Kemet-C and CP_EIA-7132-28_AVX-C.
Prioritize tier A entries over tier B entries where available.
Verify compatibility with SMD mounting and CP package family requirements.

The design requires a package family other than CP.
